levels.name: Gateplan (street level)
levels.note: Three entrances from street level (Bane NOR).

levels.name: Vestibyle / venterom (1999 vestibule)
levels.note: Bane NOR: in 1999 the station was extended to four tracks and a new vestibule with a waiting room opened. Wikipedia: 'a large, open vestibule near the surface at the entrance to Ruseløkkveien', with south-facing windows and escalators and lifts down to the platforms. No signposted level number found.
levels._source: Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-n-/nationaltheatret/, read 2026-10-30; en.wikipedia.org 'Nationaltheatret station' https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nationaltheatret_station, read 2026-10-30

levels.name: T-bane Nationaltheatret (metro platforms)
levels.note: OSM puts the metro platforms 1 and 2 at level -2. Wikipedia: the metro station is above the railway station but not directly on top of it, reached by a hallway with a green marble wall (Katrine Giæver).
levels._source: OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract NO-NTH), read 2026-10-30; en.wikipedia.org 'Nationaltheatret station' https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nationaltheatret_station, read 2026-10-30

levels.name: Plattformnivå: 'den gamle stasjonshallen' (tracks 1–2) and 'den nye stasjonshallen' (tracks 3–4)
levels.note: Bane NOR: westbound trains use tracks 1 and 2 in the old station hall, eastbound trains tracks 3 and 4 in the new station hall. Island platforms: N1/N2 and N3/N4, each 11 m wide and 700 mm high, 244 m and 251 m long (Sportabell). Wikipedia: about 30 m below the surface. OSM tags rail platforms '1;2' and '3;4' at level -3.

answers.question: Which platforms have stairs/lifts
answers.answer: Bane NOR: escalator and lift to the platforms, step-free; the station is described as universally designed. Neither Bane NOR nor Wikipedia says where each lift and escalator lands on platform 1/2 and platform 3/4.
answers._source: Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-n-/nationaltheatret/, read 2026-10-30; en.wikipedia.org 'Nationaltheatret station' https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nationaltheatret_station, read 2026-10-30

answers.question: Missing entrances
answers.answer: Three entrances: Johanne Dybwads plass (Studenterlunden/Nationaltheatret), Ruseløkkveien (main, Vika), and west at Parkveien × Henrik Ibsens gate. OSM has only the Johanne Dybwads plass / Stortingsgata side.
answers._source: Bane NOR station page https://www.banenor.no/reise-og-trafikk/stasjoner/-n-/nationaltheatret/, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract NO-NTH), read 2026-10-30

open: No lifts or escalators for the railway in the OSM extract; their positions are unknown. Bane NOR and Wikipedia confirm they exist in the main vestibule.

Signposted level names are unknown. Bane NOR uses 'gamle stasjonshallen' (tracks 1–2) and 'nye stasjonshallen' (tracks 3–4) for the platform halls. Depth is about 30 m (Wikipedia, unmeasured by an owner source).

Shops: Bane NOR says 'Flere caféer og kiosker'. Only the Narvesen and 7-Eleven at Abelhaugen were found, in the chains' store lists, with no readable hours. OSM's Narvesen (n1174966217) has no hours. Other cafés were not identified.
Lockers: none at Nationaltheatret (Bane NOR: nearest at Oslo S). Wikipedia still mentions lockers; that is out of date.
No published station plan (PDF) found for the vestibule.
